newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) higher.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) higher.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover soared to 3.332 billion yuan from 950 million yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was active on Tuesday with both state banks and non-banking financial institutions trading actively.

Non-banking financial institutions including securities houses, which trade through the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were the most active borrowers mainly due to a rise on the domestic A share markets, traders said.
The centres in Shanghai and Beijing centres were major traders in the first-tier market, traders said.
The interbank rates are likely to move narrowly in the short-term. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
